s: a hand rests a thick paperback against a rain-streaked wooden shelf in an old neighbourhood bookshop, the book filling the frame, a tomato-red cloth wall behind it, hard side-window light from the left throwing a long crisp shadow across the shelf

the product stands upright on a worn oak workbench in a craftsperson's studio against a deep-sea-blue painted wall, one hard shaft of afternoon sun from the upper right drawing its sharp shadow across the grain
the product lies open on a terracotta-orange tiled windowsill of a quiet shop, large in the frame, low hard sunlight raking in from the side so every page edge casts a clear shadow
a close crop of the product leaning on a mint-green painted wooden crate at a street-corner book stall, strong direct sun from behind-left, its dark shadow falling forward onto the crate

a thick cloth-bound book from the series stands on its spine on a worn oak counter in an old bookshop, filling most of the frame against a terracotta-orange wall, hard window light from the left throwing its sharp shadow across the wood

the book lies open in two hands over a rain-dark wooden reading table, a deep-sea-blue painted wall behind, a single hard beam from the upper right casting crisp page-edge shadows, the product large in the foreground
the product leans against the bottom shelf of a creaky timber bookcase painted tomato red, low hard afternoon sun from the right slicing across its cover and laying a long shadow on the floorboards
a close crop of the notebook resting on a mint-green tiled windowsill of a small border-town shop, strong direct sun from the left, hard shadows of the spine and corners falling sharply on the tile
the box of the series sits on a rough plank workbench in a woodworker's studio against a muted teal wall, one hard overhead-left light drawing a clean angled shadow, the box filling the frame
